node.title: Re: Efficient way to verify scalar contents
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I feel the current implementation is kind of redundant or inefficient?

It turns out to be pretty good! Compared to the other solutions so far, it's only beaten by [id://11118347|my second regex].
